questions.title: Names
questions.prompt: What should I call you, and what should you call me? You can keep Remedy, or pick another name.

questions.title: Language
questions.prompt: Which language should I use? The default is this computer's language, and I can follow what you type.

questions.title: Tone
questions.prompt: How should I talk — balanced, concise, detailed, or playful?

questions.title: Provider
questions.prompt: If you want a cloud model as muscle, which provider should I use? You can skip this and add a key later in Settings. I will not write API keys into logs or the house-rules file.

questions.title: Workspace
questions.prompt: Is there a default project folder I should use for tools and files? You can leave this empty.

questions.title: How proactive
questions.prompt: Should I reach out between visits, and keep my own drives going? Reaching out stays off unless you say yes.

questions.title: Privacy and audit
questions.prompt: Should I keep a visible audit of inner work, and turn on privacy mode that strips personal details from provider traffic?

questions.title: Token saving
questions.prompt: I can handle easy chats and pictures here on this PC, and send the muscle a short description instead of the raw image. That saves your tokens. Want that?

questions.title: Local muscle and the GPU
questions.prompt: If a local muscle (a bigger model on this PC) is running, how should we share the GPU? Auto is fine for most machines. On a 12 GB card, yielding the mind to the CPU lets a 9B muscle run at full speed.

questions.title: Consent
questions.prompt: I will always ask before spending money, sending messages, or deleting things — that's recommended and already the rule. Should I also ask before other tools run, or use the usual in-project auto mode?

questions.title: Other bots
questions.prompt: Should other bots be able to talk to me (A2A or MCP), and should I answer them automatically? Both stay off until you turn them on. Inbound connections stay on this computer and need a token.

questions.title: Updates
questions.prompt: Updates happen in the app. Should I check for them automatically and let you know, or only when you ask? Installs always wait for you.

questions.title: Start with the computer
questions.prompt: Should I start with this computer so I'm ready when you are?
